### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Accurately capture all patient-reported symptoms, including psychological states. Do not negate or omit symptoms explicitly stated by the patient.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[A-Section]: Ensure summaries of objective findings (e.g., vital signs, physical exam) precisely reflect their status. Do not generalize as 'normal' if specific abnormal values or descriptions are present. Differentiate between categories of objective findings if their statuses vary.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Report all patient-stated symptoms, including psychological states, precisely as affirmed. Never negate or contradict any symptom explicitly mentioned by the patient, even when summarizing.
